findings.finding: Q3 2026 will print a large y/y fall in pre-tax profit: Q3 2025 PBT was about DKK 236.6m (9M 144.8m less H1 -91.8m) including Champions League revenue and a Q3 transfer result of about +100m (9M 55.4 less H1 -44.8), while in 2026 Parken filed no player-sale inside-information release since the 23 Jul 2025 Froholdt sale and FCK plays the smaller Conference League.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 print (PBT down y/y 294.1 -> 144.8 for 9M, guide held): stock +5.1% on 2025-11-26; H1 2026 (loss narrowed, guide held): -0.9% then +2.8%. Y/y declines inside a held guide have not been sold here.
findings.original_quote: Resultat før skat udgjorde 144,8 mio. kr. i de første tre kvartaler af 2025 mod 294,1 mio. kr. i samme periode sidste år. (Pre-tax profit was DKK 144.8m for the first three quarters of 2025 against 294.1m in the same period last year.) / H1 2026: 'Som følge af, at de sportslige forventninger ikke blev indfriet, er der udsigt til et økonomisk meget utilfredsstillende resultat.' (As the sporting expectations were not met, a financially very unsatisfactory result is in prospect.)
findings.why_not_priced: It is mostly priced: the company cut the guide on 14 May and called the year 'meget utilfredsstillende' on 28 Aug; the stock is +18.5% over 60 days and trades on the sale process, so a weak Q3 inside the guide would have to come with a guide cut to matter. If the market feared a cut the stock would not have held 245-265 since the review announcement.
findings.independence: Flashscore summer-2026 FCK transfer list shows no departure with a disclosed fee (https://www.flashscore.nl/news/soccer-superliga-updated-danish-superliga-transfers-2026-27-every-club-s-confirmed-summer-deals/40LJdPJc/); Nasdaq Nordic feed shows no Parken inside-information transfer release May-Nov 2026.

findings.original_quote: PARKEN Sport & Entertainment A/S vil ikke kommentere på rygter eller spekulationer vedrørende potentielle interesserede investorer og yderligere selskabsmeddelelse om salgsprocessen vil således først blive udsendt, når omstændighederne måtte kræve det. (PSE will not comment on rumours or speculation about potential investors, and further announcements on the sale process will only be issued when circumstances require.)
findings.why_not_priced: The optionality is priced (the +16% re-rating); what is not priced is any update, and the company's own wording says there may be none in the report, so this carries no sign, only tail width.

baseline_tension: The lean is -0.10 (run-up only, no short anchor) and the findings are essentially flat to slightly negative, so they neither agree nor cut against it in any meaningful size; the 60-day +18.5% is the sale-review re-rating, not earnings.
language_note: All Parken releases are in Danish only (the Nasdaq feed tags some 'en' but the text is Danish), so the guide, the H1 caveat 'okonomisk meget utilfredsstillende resultat' and the sale-process wording were only available in Danish primary documents; English coverage (Flashscore, Inside World Football) carried the sale review but not the guidance numbers
The 1 Oct storaktionaermeddelelse (KPS generational handover) appears only in Danish and its English wire readings risk reading it as a stake sale
lessons_applied: 'Too small about the move' and 'size the move on what is new': abs_move_pct raised 4.0 -> 4.5 (numbers not pre-released, thin $124k/day turnover) while the likely-reiterated guide keeps it below the 7% new-numbers base
'A finding inside what the company already guided is worth ~0': the y/y Q3 decline finding cut -0.3 -> -0.2
'In a live bid, results are noise': Parken is in a strategic review, not an offer period; it kept the sale-process finding at 0 with a wide tail rather than signing it, and kept p_up at 48
